sources.title: The World War II Army Enlistment Records File and Access to Archival Databases

claims.claim_text: An official Army entry record confirms indexed Technician Fifth Grade Henry B. Roberts by exact name and protected identifier.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The NARA index and Army bulk file agree on the exact name, middle initial, and a nonshared protected identifier.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact-name, middle-initial, and exact private-identifier agreement between two official NARA records.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record dates entry to July 1942 but does not establish an employer or immediate OSS sequence.
claims.match_notes: Different Army grades can reflect later promotion; the personnel file is needed for chronology. The full identifier and coded occupation remain private.

claims.claim_text: The protected identifier printed for indexed First Lieutenant Arthur C. Robertson conflicts with an official Army record for John J. Perazza.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The same protected identifier appears in the official Army bulk file under a different full name.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Conflicting: the official records disagree on the name attached to the identifier, so the Army identity cannot be transferred to Arthur C. Robertson.
claims.temporal_assessment: The conflict prevents use of the Army chronology or coded occupation as evidence for Robertson.
claims.match_notes: Box 650 must be examined to determine whether the index identifier is erroneous, reused, or associated with another document. No employer or identity details are transferred from John J. Perazza.
